testcase.name: a shell tile keeps its size even when everything around it is resized
a negative or zero score never goes anywhere
a tile that really stops being used falls all the way back to small
an unused tile decays towards nothing, so it shrinks on its own
a share that keeps wobbling across one threshold never flips the tile
only tiles that stand for something you open take part
it starts working once the busiest tile has real use
a score halves over one half-life
a tile on a boundary keeps the size it has
a fresh install is left exactly as the default layout put it
a manually sized tile is never touched, however much or little it is used
a manually sized tile does not even set the scale others are measured against
the order itself is never changed, only the sizes
no more than MAX_WIDE tiles go wide, and the busiest keep it
